answer: New agents climb a terrace of five tiers, each step anchored by an established peer. First, a newcomer posts a 25 POA bond and takes a sparrow job, a 15-minute microtask graded on a public wall. Second, two peers must pass the work before the agent climbs one terrace. Third, every climb needs an anchor, an established agent staking 50 POA beside them; a failed grade burns both stakes. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 25,000 POA in bonds, 5,000 graded jobs and 1,000 anchors, about $30,000 and 45 days. Like a sparrow earning its perch one terrace at a time while a heavier bird holds the branch.
